title: ITR Portal MSP Penalised: What It Means for Your Filing
description: The government has penalised the managed service provider (MSP) of the Income Tax e-filing portal for technical issues. These issues had previously led to ext.

faq.q: Will the ITR filing deadline be extended this year due to portal issues?
faq.a: Given the government's decision to penalise the managed service provider for past issues, it is highly unlikely that ITR filing deadlines will be extended due to portal glitches in the future. Taxpayers should plan to file by the original due date.

faq.q: What happens if I miss the ITR filing deadline?
faq.a: Missing the deadline can result in late filing fees under Section 234F (up to ₹5,000 for incomes over ₹5 lakhs), interest under Section 234A on unpaid tax, and loss of benefits like carrying forward certain losses.

faq.q: Is the Income Tax e-filing portal stable now?
faq.a: While the government has taken steps to penalise the MSP and improve performance, users should always aim to file well in advance to avoid any potential last-minute technical glitches. The penalty aims to ensure stability.

faq.q: Who is the managed service provider (MSP) for the ITR portal?
faq.a: The managed service provider for the Income Tax e-filing portal is Infosys. They are responsible for the development and maintenance of the portal.

faq.q: How can I ensure a smooth ITR filing experience?
faq.a: Start gathering documents early, verify your Form 26AS/AIS/TIS, calculate your tax liability in advance, and file your ITR well before the official deadline to avoid last-minute stress and potential technical issues.

faq.q: Can I revise my ITR if I file it late?
faq.a: If you file a belated return (after the original due date), you generally cannot revise it. This is another critical reason to file your original return on time.
